paper: Training-free Detection of Generated Videos via Spatial-Temporal Likelihoods (Ben Hayun, Betser, Levi, Kassel, Gilboa — CVPR 2026, Technion)
training_set_in_paper: NONE — STALL is training-free/zero-shot. It uses a CALIBRATION set of REAL videos only: VATEX (~33k real videos, disjoint from all eval benchmarks) to fit the spatial+temporal PCA-whitening transforms and the calibration log-likelihood distributions (shipped as precomputed/stall_params_vatex_dino_v3.npz). No fake videos, no labels, no fine-tuning. (paper abstract; README 'Custom Calibration Set')
encoder_in_paper: DINOv3 ViT-L/16 distilled (LVD-1689M, dinov3_vitl16_pretrain_lvd1689m-8aa4cbdd.pth), frozen, D=1024 per-frame embeddings. NOT DINOv2.
paper_protocol: 8 fps over a centered 2-second window = 16 frames (decode via torchcodec); except 1-second generators (HotShot, MoonValley in GenVideo; Hotshot-XL in VideoFeedback) scored at 8 fps / 1 s = 8 frames. Frames resized 224x224. Score = average of spatial (max over frames) + temporal (min over frame-pairs) whitened-Gaussian log-likelihood percentiles vs VATEX calibration; higher=more real. Metric: AUC + AP. (README 'Reproducing Paper Results'; src/eval.py)
synthscope_encoder: DINOv3 ViT-L/16 (same as paper, gated weights). SynthScope port verified BIT-EXACT against the official STALL._scores_from_embs (0 diff). SynthScope dataset configs (comgenvid/videofeedback) normalize with normalize_dinov3; restrav README + stall README note the official DINOv3 transform actually uses ImageNet mean/std (normalize_dinov2). SynthScope recomputes calibration on the GenVideo reals (recompute_params=true) rather than using shipped VATEX params.

benchmarks.name: GenVideo (DeMamba GenVideo-Val, 10 generators + MSR-VTT)
benchmarks.paper_per_generator: Paper Table 1 reports avg AUC 0.80 / avg AP 0.80; exact per-generator values not transcribed (no per-gen table in the public arxiv HTML pull beyond ranges). HotShot+MoonValley scored at 1 s (8 frames); other 8 at 2 s (16 frames).
benchmarks.official_eval_protocol: DINOv3 ViT-L/16, 8 fps/2 s (16 frames); HotShot+MoonValley at 8 fps/1 s (8 frames). VATEX calibration. Real source MSR-VTT. AUC/AP per generator, averaged. (README GenVideo section)
benchmarks.gap_cause: REPRODUCED (slightly ABOVE paper): SynthScope mAUROC 83.51 / mAP 82.38 vs paper avg AUC 0.80 / AP 0.80 (+~2-3 pts). Difference attributable to SynthScope recomputing calibration on GenVideo reals (recompute_params=true) instead of shipped VATEX params, and SynthScope decoding all gens at a fixed 16-frame@8fps window (no per-duration 1 s split for HotShot/MoonValley). Within the paper's reported per-gen AUC range 0.72-0.85.
benchmarks.dataset_source: on-disk: /hddstore/ssalehi/SynthScope/d3_repro/genvideo_val/GenVideo-Val (14 GB; ModelScope cccnju/Gen-Video). Reals = MSR-VTT.

benchmarks.name: VideoFeedback (TIGER-Lab, 11 generators + DiDeMo + Panda70M)
benchmarks.paper_per_generator: Paper Table 1: avg AUC 0.83 / avg AP 0.85. Per-gen exact values not in the public HTML beyond ranges. Hotshot-XL (1 s) scored at 8 fps/1 s; paper retains only high dynamic-degree (level 3-4) clips (supp Table 7), but the released code uses all clips.
benchmarks.official_eval_protocol: DINOv3 ViT-L/16, 8 fps/2 s (16 frames); Hotshot-XL at 1 s (8 frames). VATEX calibration. Two real sources (DiDeMo, Panda70M), equal quota each. AUC/AP. (README VideoFeedback section)
benchmarks.gap_cause: REPRODUCED: SynthScope mAUROC 85.10 / mAP 83.07 vs paper avg AUC 0.83 / AP 0.85 (within ~0-2 pts). SynthScope uses all clips (no dynamic-degree level 3-4 filtering) and a fixed 16-frame window; the paper notes the dynamic-degree filter does not matter much. Per-gen AUROC 78-93 sits inside the paper's reported 0.78-0.93 range.
benchmarks.dataset_source: on-disk: /hddstore/ssalehi/SynthScope/VideoFeedback/test (812 MB; HF TIGER-Lab/VideoFeedback). Reals DiDeMo+Panda70M.

benchmarks.name: ComGenVid (paper's new benchmark — Sora + VEO3 vs MSVD)
benchmarks.paper_per_generator_note: These exact numbers are the official repo's reproduce-script expected output (README Mode-1 'Expected output', HF OmerXYZ/comgenvid precomputed embeddings). avg AUC 0.852 / AP 0.858.
benchmarks.official_eval_protocol: DINOv3 ViT-L/16, 8 fps/2 s (16 frames) via precomputed HF embeddings; VATEX calibration; AUC/AP. Real source MSVD. (README ComGenVid section + src/eval.py --hf-dataset OmerXYZ/comgenvid)
benchmarks.gap_cause: REPRODUCED: SynthScope mAUROC 84.00 / mAP 82.59 vs paper avg AUC 0.852 / AP 0.858 (within ~1-3 pts). Per-gen near-exact (Sora AUROC 82.4 vs 84.0; VEO3 85.6 vs 86.5). Small residual = SynthScope decoding the on-disk mp4s with decord + recomputing calibration on GenVideo reals, vs the official precomputed-VATEX-embedding path. VEO3 IS evaluated here (the gated Google Veo3 clips are bundled in ComGenVid on-disk).
benchmarks.dataset_source: on-disk: /hddstore/ssalehi/SynthScope/ComGenVid (12 GB; HF OmerXYZ/comgenvid — ships both mp4s under real/MSVD + test/, AND precomputed embeddings.parquet). Sora+VEO3 fakes, MSVD real. NOT gated.

summary.key_finding: ALL THREE STALL benchmarks (GenVideo, VideoFeedback, ComGenVid) are REPRODUCED in SynthScope using the paper's DINOv3 ViT-L/16 encoder, within ~0-3 points of paper and matching/slightly exceeding it (GenVideo 83.5 vs 80, VideoFeedback 85.1 vs 83, ComGenVid 84.0 vs 85). The SynthScope scoring math is verified BIT-EXACT against the official STALL._scores_from_embs. DINOv3 ViT-L/16 weights are GATED (Meta dinov3-downloads) but already downloaded locally (/hddstore/ssalehi/SynthScope/dinov3_checkpoints per memory). ComGenVid (incl. the gated-model VEO3 split) is fully on-disk and not gated. STALL is the cleanest of the three video repros.
